data.name: OptionReadableHint
data.value: Also opens as pages in any browser, without the app.

data.name: OptionSmall
data.comment: Checkbox on the backup page. Leaves out the full size images and keeps the thumbnails.

data.name: OptionSmallWarning
data.value: This backup can't bring back your photos at full size.
data.comment: Shown when Without full size photos is ticked.

data.name: OptionSmallNotLast
data.value: It doesn't count as your last backup, so the reminder keeps counting from your last full one.
data.comment: Shown when Without full size photos is ticked, next to the warning.

data.name: SavedSmall
data.value: It has the photos in a small size only, so it doesn't count as your last backup.
data.comment: Added to the line after a backup made without full size photos.

data.name: SavedParts
data.value: It was split into {0} files, since it is large. Each one is a whole backup that restores what is in it.
data.comment: Added to the line after a large backup. {0} is how many files.

data.name: FolderHeading
data.comment: Only in browsers that can write to a folder on the device, like Chrome and Edge.

data.name: FolderIntro
data.value: Backups go straight into a folder you choose, with nothing to find in your downloads. Old backups are never deleted or overwritten. The browser asks for permission again when you back up after closing Stikling.

data.name: FolderStop
data.comment: Forgets the folder, so backups are downloaded again.

data.name: FolderIn
data.comment: {0} is the name of the folder.

data.name: SavedInFolder
data.value: Saved a backup with {0}, {1} and {2} in the folder {3}.
data.comment: {0} is a number of plants, {1} of propagations, {2} of photos and {3} the name of the folder.

data.name: FolderFailed
data.value: Couldn't write to the folder, so the backup was downloaded instead.
data.comment: Shown when the browser refused permission or the folder is gone.
